scope: Primary-source architecture survey; not a benchmark leaderboard or deployment approval.
legacy_source_policy: This separately versioned engine inventory does not repin historical sources or promote legacy benchmark claims.

engines.name: BaseRT
engines.license_note: Apache-2.0 covers surrounding tools; core inference engine is proprietary.
engines.scope: A separately benchmarkable engine with public tooling and integration materials.
engines.limitations: The Apache-licensed repository does not make the inference engine open source; inspect license boundaries before reuse and do not claim access to its kernels.

engines.name: dflash-mlx
engines.license_note: Component/model licenses and notices remain separate; no upstream implementation is copied by this survey.
engines.scope: DFlash draft/verify adapter plus server, recurrent tape-replay rollback, hot/cold prefix snapshots and verification-specialized kernels.
engines.limitations: Greedy target verification is not identical to stochastic exact sampling; dispatch differences can alter the AR path. Sparse prefill is a separate approximate feature.

engines.name: exo
engines.license_note: Component/model licenses and notices remain separate; no upstream implementation is copied by this survey.
engines.scope: Topology-aware sharding across devices, including tensor/pipeline approaches and transport-dependent placement.
engines.limitations: Capacity across Macs is not a single-Mac latency win. Link bandwidth, collective cost and failure recovery are part of the benchmark.

engines.name: Flash-MoE
engines.license_note: Permission/coverage unresolved for code reuse; study as context only.
engines.scope: Active-expert streaming from SSD for a large sparse model on a smaller-memory Mac.
engines.limitations: Not MLX and not generic dense-model offload. No root license was found in the pinned inventory; do not copy code pending permission. SSD streaming does not remove OOM risk.

engines.name: llama.cpp
engines.license_note: Component/model licenses and notices remain separate; no upstream implementation is copied by this survey.
engines.scope: Mature non-MLX comparator with GGUF, native Metal and serving workflows.
engines.limitations: GGUF quantization and MLX quantization may not encode identical weights; report the artifact/quality difference rather than an engine-only ratio.

engines.name: mistral.rs

methods.approach: Separate process/load, request first-content latency, physical prefill, cached tokens, decode and end-to-end time; disclose observed model width.
methods.correctness: Monotonic parent timing; valid token accounting; no heartbeat counted as a token; preserve failure rows.
methods.measure: Cold/warm/partial-prefix runs, p50/p95 latency, aggregate throughput, RSS/Metal/cache/swap separately.
methods.rollback: Reject comparison or keep baseline when artifact, workload, precision, hardware or metric semantics differ.

methods.bottleneck: Requests or model pools exceed usable memory
methods.approach: Reserve model plus projected KV/state/activation growth and system headroom before admission; bound queues and eviction.
methods.correctness: Mixed long/short overload, pinned-model constraints, cancellation releases leases, rejected requests produce explicit errors.
methods.measure: Peak and steady memory, queue time, admission failures, eviction stalls, tail latency.
methods.rollback: Reduce admission or unload safely; never silently reduce context or quantize weights.

methods.bottleneck: Fragile interpreters and incompatible native kernels
methods.approach: Pin the entire executable/dependency/native-library environment and probe the actual compiled backend capabilities.
methods.correctness: Relocatable environment launch, correct ABI/library resolution, no ambient packages; first real workload inside the intended isolation.
methods.measure: Cold load, warm load, compiler/startup work, packaging size and selected/fallback kernel counters.
methods.rollback: Refuse unsupported ABI/device paths and keep a tested runtime; do not broaden sandbox permissions to hide failures.

methods.bottleneck: Compatible endpoints behave differently for real clients
methods.approach: Test exact tool/reasoning/template, usage, stop, cancellation and error semantics with versioned client transcripts.
methods.correctness: Malformed tools fail; unsupported controls fail explicitly; disconnect halts work; no hidden template/sampling change.
methods.measure: First-content latency, successful tool round trips, stream errors and cancellation cleanup.
methods.rollback: Fall back to a declared supported route or return an explicit unsupported error.

methods.bottleneck: Repeated prompts recompute or state restore is unsafe
methods.approach: Use topology-specific immutable checkpoints, copy-on-write and leases; recurrent state cannot be reconstructed by slicing ordinary KV.
methods.correctness: Cold-vs-warm next-token/logit and multi-turn checks; exact prefix length; rollback; tenant and adapter/media identity mutation tests.
methods.measure: Exact and partial hit rates, restored versus computed tokens, clone bytes and restoration cost.
methods.rollback: Invalidate incompatible/corrupt state and recompute; never reuse partially qualified hybrid state.

methods.bottleneck: A long prefill starves ongoing generations
methods.approach: Token-budget chunking interleaves prefill and decoding; continuous batching must expose actual compute widths and safe per-request state.
methods.correctness: Unequal lengths, left padding/masks, per-request sampler/stop, cancellation at chunk boundaries, no starvation.
methods.measure: Prefill versus decode latency, p95 inter-token time, observed width, queue depth and aggregate tokens.
methods.rollback: Reduce chunk/concurrency budget or revert to single-request execution when quality or tail latency regresses.

methods.bottleneck: Vision/audio processing is repeated or a text cache aliases media
methods.approach: Separate encoder-output and language-state caches; bind media content and processor/frame/audio settings to exact cache identity.
methods.correctness: Same text with changed image/audio/frame order must miss; processor/template/adapter/tenant changes invalidate.
methods.measure: Encoder latency, media bytes, prompt prefill, first-audio and first-text boundaries separately.
methods.rollback: Disable the media cache and re-encode when identity or restored-state qualification is missing.

methods.bottleneck: Reusable prefix state exceeds the hot-cache budget
methods.approach: Bound hot RAM and cold SSD stores with explicit format/version, checksums, atomic writes and per-namespace limits.
methods.correctness: Interrupted write/restart, checksum failure, partial restore, lease/eviction races, no cross-tenant hits.
methods.measure: SSD reads/writes, restore latency, physical and apparent prefill rates, hot/cold hits and resident state.
methods.rollback: Evict or ignore bad snapshots and recompute; keep model-weight fit and SSD-cache capacity as separate budgets.

methods.bottleneck: Serial target decoding is bandwidth/dispatch bound
methods.approach: Pair exact target/draft artifacts; optimize the verification shape, track acceptance and retain ordinary decode as a selectable baseline.
methods.correctness: Greedy and sampled paths separately; residual correction where sampling is claimed; rejected-token KV/GDN rollback; repeated seed/distribution checks.
methods.measure: Accepted tokens per verification, draft/verify/rollback time, depth, context and short-output break-even.
methods.rollback: Disable speculation when total useful progress is slower or any target-quality/state gate fails.

methods.bottleneck: Attention or small verification matmuls dominate the profile
methods.approach: Use variable-length paged attention and shape/device-specialized fused kernels behind explicit capability guards and a readable reference.
methods.correctness: Dtype/layout/mask/group-size/length boundary parity; packaged metallib/ABI checks; safe fallback for unsupported shapes.
methods.measure: Per-phase kernel/launch time, command-buffer/synchronization cost, prefill/decode/verify separately.
methods.rollback: Revert the exact kernel path on parity, unsupported hardware, allocation or tail-latency regression.

methods.bottleneck: Lower precision or less computation is presented as free speed
methods.approach: Treat KV/weight quantization, expert reduction, sparse prefill and context compaction as separate task-quality experiments.
methods.correctness: Full model/task metrics and long-context tests; distinguish packed resident storage from a codec with a full-precision shadow.
methods.measure: Actual resident bytes including shadows/scales, quality deltas and phase timing at the same output policy.
methods.rollback: Restore precision/expert count/context path if the predeclared task-quality threshold fails.

methods.bottleneck: Sparse model weights exceed memory but few experts are active
methods.approach: Stream only required expert/table data, overlap bounded I/O, and preserve exact router selections.
methods.correctness: Match resident execution token/logit/router results; cold SSD stalls and disk failure must fail safely.
methods.measure: SSD bandwidth, page faults, cold/warm expert locality, resident buffers and sustained decode.
methods.rollback: Use a smaller model or resident path when I/O stalls or memory headroom fails; never claim streaming eliminates OOM risk.

methods.bottleneck: A model requires multiple Macs or heterogeneous memory
methods.approach: Choose tensor versus pipeline partitioning from measured compute/link budgets rather than aggregate RAM alone.
methods.correctness: Shard identity, full-model parity, rank failure/recovery and collective synchronization.
methods.measure: Per-rank time, link latency/bandwidth, serial and concurrent latency, total energy and cost.
methods.rollback: Return to a validated smaller topology or single-host model when communication dominates.

methods.bottleneck: Text metrics hide unusable audio latency or quality
methods.approach: Treat speech as a pipeline: frontend, acoustic model, codec/vocoder, chunk flush and playback lead time.
methods.correctness: WER/CER where appropriate, speaker/prosody fidelity, continuity across chunks, cancellation and long-form drift.
methods.measure: First-audio latency; real-time factor defined as compute seconds divided by generated audio seconds; peak memory and underruns.
methods.rollback: Keep the prior audio pipeline if task or continuity gates regress even when text generation speeds improve.
